_comment: OPT-IN telemetry for ADLC Mission Control. Merge this `env` block into the repo's .claude/settings.local.json (or settings.json) so Claude Code sends each model reply's tokens, cost and duration to Mission Control on this machine. No collector and no Docker: Mission Control receives OTLP over HTTP/JSON itself. Only new sessions pick it up. If you already use templates/settings.telemetry.json (the Docker collector), use one or the other: both set the same keys.
